name: Babylon Finance
technique: Affected by the Rari Capital vulnerability
rootCause: In April, attackers exploited a vulnerability to steal $80 million from Rari Capital, and the asset management project Babylon Finance, Rari's main lending pool, lost $3.4 million as a result. On Aug. 31, Babylon Finance founder Ramon Recuero published a blog post announcing that Babylon would be shutting down and pledging to distribute remaining project funds to holders.
